payload.summary_zh: GEOFlow 2.2.0 新增匿名成功登录统计，覆盖后台 Web 与 API 渠道，并保持登录流程、失败事件和个人信息与中央监控隔离。
payload.summary_en: GEOFlow 2.2.0 adds anonymous successful-login telemetry for admin web and API channels while keeping login flow, failed attempts, and personal information isolated from central monitoring.
payload.upgrade_tip_zh: 本版本未新增业务迁移。升级代码和前端资源后运行 php artisan migrate --force 与 php artisan geoflow:security-audit，并重启 queue worker；从较早版本升级时继续按受管图片 readiness 流程完成删除门禁检查。
payload.upgrade_tip_en: This release adds no application migration. Update the code and frontend assets, run php artisan migrate --force and php artisan geoflow:security-audit, then restart queue workers. When upgrading from older versions, complete the managed-image deletion readiness checks.
